description: A held ACOUSTIC-CUE VOCABULARY for grounding teacher advice. When the speech-autonomy loop stalls and the LLM teacher (a help-button) returns free-text method-advice (e.g. 'use FORMANT TRANSITIONS / the F2 trajectory' or 'attend to VOICE-ONSET-TIME (VOT)'), the OLD cue extractor minted SEMANTICALLY-EMPTY tokens ('faculty_stalls', 'scoring_static') from the first two content words, losing the real acoustic cue. This seed holds the canonical cue terms + their surface-forms as graph data (AcousticCue nodes), and a graph-native cue-extraction Term (acoustic_cue_match) that MATCHES the advice text against the held surface-forms via substrate.evaluate (StringIndexOf over each form, Pick the first matching cue) and returns the matched canonical cue. The grounding DECISION is the Term (donkey=0), not Python and not an LLM call. Advice with no known cue matches nothing -> no garbage axis is minted (honest no-grounding). Canonical cues are grounded in the agent's EXISTING speech cue machinery (domains.hint_grounding.CUE_MENU operators: onset_tilt / vowel_height / movement / onset_level / ending_level / f1_formant / f2_formant / f2_minus_f1) via each cue's `operator` attr where one exists.

microtheory.name: acoustic_cue_vocab
microtheory.description: canonical acoustic cue terms + surface-forms (held graph data) + a graph-native vocabulary-match Term that grounds teacher advice to the real cue it names.

nodes.comment: f2_trajectory precedes the generic formant_transition so advice naming F2 SPECIFICALLY grounds to the specific cue (Filter returns graph order, Pick takes the first match); plain formant-movement advice with no F2 falls through to formant_transition.

concepts.name: acoustic_cue_match
concepts.comment: GRAPH-NATIVE cue extraction (donkey=0): given the teacher's advice text bound on env var `adv` (lowercased by the host I/O boundary), Pick the FIRST held AcousticCue whose any surface-form occurs in the advice. `Filter` walks the held AcousticCue nodes in graph order; the per-cue predicate is `Exists(surface_forms, f, StringIndexOf(adv, f) >= 0)` = 'some held surface-form of this cue appears in the advice'. `Pick` returns the first matching cue node (or None if none match -> honest no-grounding). The MATCH DECISION is this Term, evaluated via substrate.evaluate; no LLM, no Python if/else. The canonical cue is then read off the picked node's `canonical` attr (and its `operator` for investigated_by wiring). REPLACES the old `_advice_cue_node` first-2-content-words heuristic as the source of the grown axis's identity.
